name: czgame_frame_on_paint
description: CZGameFrame::OnPaint paints the cached game bitmap through CPaintDC unless the 3dfx cached-client-rect update mask suppresses the blit.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja decompilation renders CPaintDC HDC guards and the CBitmap handle load in compiler-lowered form, but current assembly evidence and source ABI asserts cover the behavior used by OnPaint.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x443900 validates CPaintDC construction/destruction, zVid_QueryCachedClientRectUpdateMaskIf3dfx skip behavior, PAINTSTRUCT copy from CPaintDC, CreateCompatibleDC from the paint HDC, SelectObject of self->m_gameBitmap.m_hObject, BitBlt when paint height is <= 480, StretchBlt with source size 640x480 when paint height is > 480, and DeleteDC cleanup.

The dependency frontier for 0x443900 has no authored source blockers; CPaintDC, GDI calls, and EH cleanup are provider/compiler behavior and zVid_QueryCachedClientRectUpdateMaskIf3dfx is accepted functional evidence.

The native smoke patches the GDI imports and verifies BitBlt, StretchBlt, DeleteDC, selected bitmap handle, source/destination rectangles, raster op, and the 3dfx update-mask skip path through a real CPaintDC on a temporary window.
